meta.name: Household B - single earner, heavy debt
meta.description: A 38-year-old surgeon out of a long training path, sole earner. Gross ~$600k, ~$370,000 net. $50,000 invested -- a late start with a large balance outstanding. Real income held flat. All figures are real 2026 dollars, net of tax. Savings, student loans, housing and education are grid dimensions.
